title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: mac > Nakamichi 680ZX > Tascam CD RW5000 > Bias Peak 3.21 on G4 Powerbook > wav > flac
source: Nakamichi  CM300 shotguns  > Technics 686 > Maxell UD XL II

ai_review.summary: Great outdoor festival show with a tight, high‑energy set and good‑quality audience recording that captures crisp vocals and the iconic Shakedown Street vibe.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its upbeat tempo, standout renditions of Shakedown Street, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Sugar Magnolia, Truckin' and other classics, and a lively festival atmosphere. The recording—likely an audience/matrix capture—is generally clear and snappy, though one reviewer notes a loss of mid‑range on Phil’s bass, giving it a solid but not flawless sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Nine out of ten reviewers gave 5 stars and highlighted the show’s energy and song selection; only one noted a bass‑frequency issue, so the combined show (70%) and recording (30%) rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp outdoor sound with clear vocals and extra wah‑wah on Shakedown Street; overall tight mix but noticeable sub‑bass boost and missing mid‑range on Phil's bass.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Up‑tempo, festival‑morning slot with smooth transitions (notably Shakedown Street into the next numbers) and a consistently high‑energy feel throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Several reviewers note that Phil's bass is heavy on sub‑bass but missing mids, making his tone sound thin in this recording.
